capabilities: Fetch new messages from the MAX Sync backend using a bot-issued user token
Append incoming messages to a target note using a template
Download media attachments into an attachments folder
Insert transcribed audio text and tags via template variables
disambiguation: Not a vault-syncing tool like Obsidian Sync; it imports chat messages from the MAX messenger into a note.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.5.0+). Requires running a separate MAX Sync backend and requesting a personal token from a bot; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull chat messages and their media from the MAX messenger into notes.

relations.evidence: Sync messages from MAX messenger into your Obsidian vault.

summary: Syncs messages from MAX messenger into a vault note via a companion sync server, appending templated entries and downloading media attachments.
